verdict.rationale: Intel's marketing pages say the chip has low-power AI engines, intelligent power management, and power efficiency that lets the battery last longer and keep performing unplugged. These are generic vendor claims, partly from broad Core-family pages rather than 258V-specific material, so they only glancingly cover the story. Missing for 10: evidence of shipping fanless or thin-and-quiet designs, quantified battery-life figures (hours or runtime tests), 258V-specific power or TDP documentation, and independent or hands-on battery-life corroboration.
